plan.question: Does the completed query/history routing factorial retain a positive validation ROC-AUC interaction and a joint-routing advantage over the full-gradient control at permitted independent paired seeds? The own/own, query-only, history-only and both-role cells have AUCs 0.6149816911798147, 0.6149975212950974, 0.6148160124614166 and 0.6151021885074872: interaction +0.00027034593078789637, joint-minus-full +0.00012049732767249743. Logloss interaction is -0.00005161847028653521. Neither single-role intervention improves the incumbent. These seed42 outcomes establish conditional performance nonadditivity; shared-table gradient cancellation and optimizer mediation remain unidentified. Prioritize robustness of the existing factorial before another donor or architecture search, retaining original DIN and the rank-adjacent loss leader as comparators.

Prior two-state training probes and synthetic VJPs do not distinguish cancellation, unchanged-path dilution, Adam amplification, nonlinear optimization or checkpoint selection.
